persons.name: Bhājudhana
persons.evidence: pāsā bhājudhaṇ dvānyā bhājudhaṃ dvānyā bhājudhaṃ jamādāra

notes: The chronogram 'rāmādrivivara' yields 973 (rāma = 3, adri = 7, vivara = 9). 'kṣapākara' refers to the moon, i.e., Monday (Somavāra). An appended entry immediately following the verse reads: 'saṃvat 973 kārttika vadi 11 śrīdattareva gayāśrāddha ṣaḍdina pāsā bhājudhaṇ dvānyā bhājudhaṃ dvānyā bhājudhaṃ jamādāra strīpuruṣaṃ luja śubhaṃ', recording a Gayā-śrāddha pilgrimage or companion record involving Bhājudhana.
